prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1136; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and pain radiating into the upper arm. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior glenohumeral joint, limited active abduction and forward flexion, and positive impingement testing. Imaging ruled out fracture, and the working diagnosis was right rotator cuff strain with associated capsulitis.

Over the course of 27 visits, treatment consisted of a structured physical therapy program focusing on pain modulation, progressive range-of-motion exercises, scapular stabilization, and graded strengthening. Adjunctive care included therapeutic ultrasound, soft tissue mobilization, and home exercise instruction. Pain scores and functional measures improved steadily across the treatment period, and the patient regained near-full active range of motion with only mild residual weakness during overhead activity.

At discharge, the patient was independent with a home exercise program and reported that activities of daily living were largely unrestricted. Ongoing precautions include avoiding repetitive overhead lifting for several weeks. Follow-up care is recommended on an as-needed basis should symptoms recur.
